name: lucy
about: her partial skeleton, found in ethiopia, showed that human ancestors walked upright long before their brains grew large

name: ötzi
role: a copper age man found frozen in the alps
about: his body, clothing, tools, and even stomach contents survived, giving a rare close look at a single prehistoric life

name: narmer
about: traditionally credited with uniting upper and lower egypt; the narmer palette shows him wearing both crowns

name: khufu
about: the great pyramid of giza was built as his tomb

name: sargon of akkad
about: conquered the sumerian city-states and created what is often called the first empire

name: enheduanna
role: high priestess of ur and poet
about: the daughter of sargon, she is the earliest author in history known by name

name: hammurabi
about: built a large kingdom in mesopotamia and published one of the best known early law codes

name: hatshepsut
about: one of the few women to rule egypt as pharaoh; her reign was peaceful and prosperous, and she built the temple at deir el-bahri

name: akhenaten
about: tried to replace egypt's many gods with worship of the aten, the sun disk, and built a new capital at amarna

name: nefertiti
about: wife of akhenaten and a powerful figure in her own right; her painted bust is one of the most famous works of ancient art

name: tutankhamun
about: a young king who restored the old gods after akhenaten; his nearly intact tomb made him famous

name: ramesses ii
about: ruled for 66 years, fought the hittites at kadesh, and built huge monuments such as abu simbel

name: homer
about: the name given to the poet of the iliad and the odyssey; whether one person composed both is debated

name: zoroaster
about: founder of zoroastrianism, which saw the world as a struggle between good and evil; his dates are very uncertain

name: cyrus the great
role: founder of the achaemenid persian empire
about: conquered media, lydia, and babylon, and was remembered for letting conquered peoples keep their customs

name: darius i
about: organized the persian empire into provinces, built roads, and launched the first invasion of greece

name: laozi
about: traditionally the author of the dao de jing and founder of daoism; he may be partly legendary

name: confucius
about: taught that a good society rests on proper relationships, respect for family, and rulers who lead by virtue

name: siddhartha gautama
about: a prince who gave up his wealth to seek an end to suffering and taught the four noble truths and the eightfold path; some date him about 80 years earlier

name: mahavira
about: taught strict non-violence toward all living things; jains count him as the last of 24 great teachers

name: pericles
about: led athens in its golden age, backed democracy and the building of the parthenon, and died of plague early in the war with sparta

name: herodotus
about: called the father of history; his histories tell the story of the persian wars and the peoples involved

name: socrates
about: questioned everything, wrote nothing, and was executed for corrupting the young; we know him through plato

name: plato
about: student of socrates, founder of the academy, and author of the republic

name: aristotle
about: wrote on logic, biology, ethics, politics, and more; teacher of alexander the great

name: alexander the great
about: conquered the persian empire and reached india by the age of 30, spreading greek culture across the east

name: chandragupta maurya
about: united most of northern india after alexander's invasion; tradition says he later became a jain monk

name: ashoka
about: after the bloody conquest of kalinga he embraced buddhism and carved edicts about kindness across his empire

name: archimedes
about: worked out the principles of levers and buoyancy and estimated pi; killed when rome took syracuse

name: qin shi huang
about: united china, standardized writing, money, and measures, and was buried with the terracotta army

name: hannibal
about: crossed the alps with elephants and crushed roman armies at cannae, but carthage still lost the war

name: sima qian
about: wrote the records of the grand historian, the model for chinese history writing for two thousand years

name: julius caesar
about: conquered gaul, won a civil war, and was murdered by senators who feared he would become king

name: cleopatra
about: allied with julius caesar and then mark antony; after their defeat by octavian, egypt became a roman province

name: augustus
about: ended the civil wars, kept the look of the republic while holding real power, and began the pax romana

name: jesus of nazareth
role: jewish teacher, central figure of christianity
about: preached love of god and neighbor and the coming kingdom of god; crucified under pontius pilate

name: paul of tarsus
about: spread christianity to non-jews around the eastern mediterranean; his letters are the oldest christian writings

name: cai lun
about: credited with improving papermaking using bark, hemp, and rags

name: constantine
about: the first christian emperor; ended persecution of christians and founded constantinople

name: ezana
about: converted to christianity and made aksum one of the first christian states

name: aryabhata
about: calculated pi closely, explained eclipses, and argued that the earth spins on its axis

name: justinian
about: reconquered much of the old western empire, built the hagia sophia, and gathered roman law into one code

name: muhammad
about: a merchant of mecca who, muslims believe, received the quran from god; he united arabia under islam

name: wu zetian
about: the only woman to rule china as emperor in her own name; she expanded the exam system and backed buddhism

name: charlemagne
about: united much of western europe and encouraged learning; crowned emperor by the pope in 800

name: al-khwarizmi
about: his book gave us the word algebra, and his name gave us the word algorithm

name: ibn sina
about: known in europe as avicenna; his canon of medicine was a standard textbook for centuries

name: murasaki shikibu
about: wrote the tale of genji, often called the world's first novel

name: leif erikson
about: led the voyage that reached vinland, part of north america, about five centuries before columbus

name: william the conqueror
role: duke of normandy, king of england
about: won the battle of hastings in 1066 and ordered the domesday book survey

name: saladin
about: united muslim lands against the crusaders and retook jerusalem in 1187; famed even among enemies for chivalry

name: genghis khan
about: united the mongol tribes and launched conquests that created the largest land empire in history

name: sundiata keita
about: his story is told in the epic of sundiata, still performed by west african griots

name: thomas aquinas
about: tried to show that christian faith and aristotle's reason could fit together

name: kublai khan
about: grandson of genghis; conquered the song and founded the yuan dynasty

name: marco polo
about: his account of the court of kublai khan gave europeans a picture of asia

name: mansa musa
about: his lavish pilgrimage to mecca made mali famous; he built mosques and schools in timbuktu

name: ibn battuta
about: journeyed about 120,000 kilometers through the islamic world, india, china, and west africa

name: ibn khaldun
about: his muqaddimah tried to explain why dynasties rise and fall, an early work of social science

name: zheng he
about: led seven huge treasure fleets across the indian ocean to arabia and east africa

name: joan of arc
role: french peasant girl and military leader
about: said voices told her to save france; she lifted the siege of orléans and was burned by the english

name: pachacuti
about: turned the kingdom of cusco into a great empire and likely built machu picchu

name: johannes gutenberg
about: developed movable metal type and the printing press in europe

name: mehmed ii
about: conquered constantinople in 1453 and made it his capital

name: leonardo da vinci
about: painted the mona lisa and the last supper and filled notebooks with studies of anatomy and machines

name: christopher columbus
about: reached the caribbean in 1492, opening lasting contact between europe and the americas; his rule there was brutal

name: vasco da gama
about: the first european to reach india by sea

name: michelangelo
about: carved david and painted the sistine chapel ceiling

name: nicolaus copernicus
about: argued that the earth and planets orbit the sun

name: martin luther
about: his attack on indulgences began the protestant reformation; he translated the bible into german

name: moctezuma ii
about: ruled the aztec empire at its height and died in spanish captivity

name: hernán cortés
about: conquered the aztec empire with the help of tens of thousands of indigenous allies

name: malintzin
about: also called la malinche; her skill with languages was crucial to cortés, and her role is still argued over in mexico

name: ferdinand magellan
about: led the first expedition to sail around the world; he was killed in the philippines

name: suleiman the magnificent
about: expanded the empire, reformed its laws, and presided over its golden age

name: atahualpa
about: won a civil war against his brother, then was captured and executed by pizarro

name: akbar
about: expanded the empire across northern india and held debates between scholars of different faiths

name: elizabeth i
about: saw off the spanish armada; her reign was a golden age of english drama

name: william shakespeare
about: wrote hamlet, macbeth, romeo and juliet, and dozens more plays still performed around the world

name: galileo galilei
about: used the telescope to support copernicus and was forced by the church to take it back

name: tokugawa ieyasu
about: won the battle of sekigahara and founded the shogunate that ruled japan until 1868

name: yi sun-sin
about: defeated the japanese navy again and again with his turtle ships

name: shah jahan
about: built the taj mahal in memory of his wife

name: queen nzinga
about: fought and negotiated with the portuguese for decades to keep her kingdoms in angola free

name: isaac newton
about: described gravity and the laws of motion, and co-invented calculus

name: peter the great
about: modernized russia, built a navy, and founded st petersburg

name: john locke
about: argued that people have natural rights and that governments rule by the consent of the governed

name: voltaire
about: attacked religious intolerance and censorship with sharp wit

name: jean-jacques rousseau
about: wrote that legitimate government comes from the general will of the people

name: adam smith
about: the wealth of nations argued that free markets and division of labor create prosperity

name: james watt
about: his improved steam engine powered the industrial revolution

name: george washington
about: led the continental army to victory and then stepped down after two terms

name: thomas jefferson
about: wrote the declaration of independence while enslaving more than 600 people over his life

name: olaudah equiano
about: his autobiography of enslavement and freedom helped turn british opinion against the slave trade

name: toussaint louverture
about: a formerly enslaved man who led haiti's revolution; captured by napoleon's forces, he died in a french prison

name: mary wollstonecraft
about: argued that women are not naturally inferior but only lack education

name: maximilien robespierre
about: led the reign of terror before he was himself guillotined

name: napoleon bonaparte
about: conquered most of europe, spread the napoleonic code, and was finally beaten at waterloo

name: jean-jacques dessalines
about: led the final defeat of the french and declared haiti's independence in 1804

name: simón bolívar
about: led the independence of venezuela, colombia, ecuador, peru, and bolivia

name: shaka
about: reorganized the zulu army and built a powerful kingdom in southern africa

name: william wilberforce
about: led the campaign in parliament to end the slave trade

name: karl marx
about: argued that history is driven by class struggle and predicted a workers' revolution

name: charles darwin
about: explained how species evolve by natural selection

name: abraham lincoln
role: sixteenth president of the united states
about: led the union through the civil war and moved to end slavery; assassinated in 1865

name: frederick douglass
about: escaped slavery and became one of the most powerful speakers against it

name: harriet tubman
about: escaped slavery and guided dozens of others to freedom on the underground railroad

name: otto von bismarck
about: unified germany through three short wars and then kept the peace with a web of alliances

name: emperor meiji
about: reigned during japan's rapid transformation into a modern industrial power

name: menelik ii
about: defeated italy at adwa in 1896 and kept ethiopia independent

name: leopold ii
about: ran the congo as his private property through terror and forced labor

name: marie curie
about: discovered polonium and radium and was the first person to win nobel prizes in two sciences

name: cixi
about: the real power at the qing court for nearly fifty years

name: emmeline pankhurst
about: led a militant campaign for women's right to vote

name: albert einstein
about: developed the theories of relativity, changing our understanding of space, time, and gravity

name: sun yat-sen
about: called the father of modern china; first president of the republic of china

name: vladimir lenin
about: led the bolshevik revolution and founded the soviet state

name: mahatma gandhi
about: led mass non-violent resistance against british rule; assassinated in 1948

name: mustafa kemal atatürk
about: built a secular republic from the ruins of the ottoman empire

name: joseph stalin
about: industrialized the soviet union by force; millions died in his famines, purges, and labor camps

name: benito mussolini
about: founded fascism and allied with hitler

name: adolf hitler
about: started the second world war in europe and ordered the holocaust

name: franklin d. roosevelt
about: led the country through the great depression and most of the second world war

name: winston churchill
about: led britain through the second world war and refused to make peace with hitler

name: anne frank
about: hid from the nazis in amsterdam for two years; her diary was published after she died in bergen-belsen

name: mao zedong
about: won the chinese civil war; his great leap forward and cultural revolution cost tens of millions of lives

name: jawaharlal nehru
about: led india for its first seventeen years and helped found the non-aligned movement

name: kwame nkrumah
about: led ghana to independence in 1957 and championed african unity

name: rosa parks
about: her refusal to give up her bus seat sparked the montgomery bus boycott

name: martin luther king jr.
about: led non-violent campaigns against segregation; won the nobel peace prize and was assassinated

name: rosalind franklin
about: her x-ray images were key to discovering the structure of dna

name: yuri gagarin
about: the first human in space, in 1961

name: neil armstrong
about: the first person to walk on the moon, in 1969

name: mikhail gorbachev
role: last leader of the soviet union
about: his reforms opened the soviet system and helped end the cold war peacefully

name: deng xiaoping
about: opened china's economy to markets, setting off decades of rapid growth

name: nelson mandela
role: anti-apartheid leader and president of south africa
about: spent 27 years in prison, then led the country's peaceful move to democracy

name: tim berners-lee
about: invented the world wide web

name: wangari maathai
about: founded the green belt movement, which planted tens of millions of trees; first african woman to win the nobel peace prize
